name: qkd_ke_tm_ref

job.purpose: q13-kvleaves: hard tile of the thin-cluster KV end (ot_qkvd_kv_end SPL=1) -- link TX head mux (grant-selected, local gq2 copies) + tf0 word relay, next to the TX buffers (540 flops). M5 leaf, every face pin registered, own clock root.
job.structural_change: kv_end thin cluster: ot_qkvd_d2d's own 11.5k registers are cut into hard pin-registered tiles with their own clock roots (ke_ti x3, ke_rq, ke_tm, ke_tf, ke_ro x4, ke_ctl, ke_wf); the cluster keeps no register and only distributes the clock to child clock pins (flat parents qkd_d2d_ref-q10 / qkd_d2d_pf_ref-q13: one root over 11.5k registers + hard buffers, spine insertion 2.07-2.5 ns, FF hold -142 / -216, DRC 31 / 35); ke_tm pin plan: the three head bits of every word bit on adjacent S-face pins and tw[i] straight above (explicit io_tcl), so the 3:1 mux is a local column (q16b: three 75-um bus ranges, global route congestion GRT-0116 in the 10.8-um core)
